purpose: Tracks the last commit reviewed by the scheduled bug-review routine. Update `last_reviewed_sha` to the current HEAD after each review pass; the next run reviews only commits in `last_reviewed_sha..HEAD`.

confirmed.summary: write_pgn_game emits colliding game numbers across pool opponents in the same cycle — with pool_size=3, gps=4, cycle=5, three PGN entries share header 'Eval Cycle 5 Game 1', three share 'Game 2', etc.; downstream tools indexing by (cycle, game_num) see ambiguous entries.

SCORE formula hardcodes '- 1500.0' while training's baseline is the configurable HYZERO_OPPONENT_INITIAL_ELO — setting the env var to 1400 makes a matched candidate score (1400-1500)*0.05 = -5.0 (spurious regression).

suspicious.summary: After first promotion, pool excludes champion_version and the only archive is best_v001.pt, so pool is empty and cycle 2 re-enters bootstrap emitting misleading 'unexpected archive deletion' WARN; Elo path only activates after the second promotion.
Four new HYZERO_* env vars use .parse().ok().unwrap_or(default), silently reverting to defaults on typos; startup banner prints resolved value so no baseline notice would flag it.

candidate_elo accumulates across all pool members treating each as rating=1500; with large pool_size a genuinely stronger candidate may asymptote just under 1500 + promotion_elo_delta — check whether the gate needs to scale with pool_size.

notes_for_next_run: On next run, review commits in bde4f9b..HEAD; update last_reviewed_sha to the new HEAD after finishing. Do NOT re-review confirmed/suspicious findings above unless they were addressed by a fix commit in the new range.
